desc: The guest playing Mario uses an item at once and the host's game applies it: under a 150 ms simulated round trip the guest takes Mario's seat (the host says yes), the host's game gets a Mushroom, and the guest uses it on Mario from its Start menu (TTYD_SYNC_ITEM_TEST: the headless build has no menu to walk): the pouch and HP change on the guest's screen in that frame (0 frames), the use goes to the host as C_USE with its number, and the host's game applies it and answers done

log_must: co-op: player 2's item 148 from Mario's Start menu
test: this guest \(Mario\) uses item 148 from its Start menu
fieldact: item #\d+ \(148 on 0\) shown here 0 frames after its press
fieldact: the host's word on item #\d+: done \(used\)
log_must_not: fieldact: the host's word on item #\d+: refused
